column2: After years of constant warfare and battles involving hundreds of thousands of soldiers, the Hobgoblin hordes have broken through Cathay's western defences and put the provinces near [GetRandomCathayanRegion] to the torch. Yet the Dragon Throne does not fall. [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetDynName], the immortal Dragon Emperor, has paid the Khagan a fortune in jade and silk to take his hordes home. Cathay is shaken, and unrest is likely to follow.
